evidence.observation: Settled at about 3-6 ppm after the purge and stayed there through the ramp; 5.5 ppm at 2640 s
Rose steadily during growth: 13.2, 19.4, 27.1, 33.2 ppm (2760-3120 s)
Flow steady at about 100 sccm, matching setpoint, so the mass flow controller looks fine
Pressure steady at about 761 Torr with no rise, so an exhaust blockage is unlikely
Holding 750 °C with steady heater power, so the thermocouple and heater look fine

args.missing_evidence: A leak check (isolate the tube and watch the pressure rise, or apply a leak-detection spray to the seals) to confirm air is getting in. Also confirmation that the O2 sensor is not drifting, e.g. by comparing it with a reference.
